# Reconify

> Reconify is a Go CLI and library for reconciling financial CSV data from banks, PSPs, ledgers, and spreadsheets. Agents can read this file to get a fast, accurate picture of the project without reading all the source code.

## Start

- [Project orientation](AGENTS.md): canonical agent guide — read this first
- [Human README](README.md): user-facing setup and CLI examples
- [Example config](examples/reconify.yaml): full working `reconify.yaml` with all optional fields
- [CLI entrypoint](cmd/reconify/main.go): main binary
- [CLI commands](internal/cli/): Cobra command implementations
- [Config model](config/config.go): YAML struct definitions and validation rules (source of truth for config shape)
- [Reconciliation engine](engine/): parser, reconciler, indexes, output writers
- [Type definitions](engine/transaction.go): Transaction, Summary, MatchedPair, all event types

## Agent Workflows (Skills)

Install all skills into any project with:

```bash
npx @reconifyhq/skills
```

This writes skill files into `.agents/skills/`, `.claude/skills/`, and `.codex/skills/` in the current directory. Skills already present are overwritten with the latest version.

- [Reconcile skill](/.agents/skills/reconify-engine-reconcile/SKILL.md): full Engine workflow
- [CLI skill](/.agents/skills/reconify-engine-cli/SKILL.md): commands, flags, output formats
- [Config skill](/.agents/skills/reconify-engine-config/SKILL.md): create or validate `reconify.yaml`
- [Performance skill](/.agents/skills/reconify-engine-performance/SKILL.md): benchmarks and indexes
- [Debug skill](/.agents/skills/reconify-engine-debug/SKILL.md): interpret results and exceptions
- [Bootstrap skill](/.agents/skills/reconify-engine-bootstrap/SKILL.md): new project setup
- [CI skill](/.agents/skills/reconify-engine-ci/SKILL.md): deterministic CI workflows

## Commands

- Quick tests: `go test ./...`
- Race detection + coverage: `make test`
- Lint: `make lint`
- Build CLI: `make build`
- Inspect CLI: `go run ./cmd/reconify --help`
- Machine-readable schema: `go run ./cmd/reconify config schema`
- Engine capability discovery: `go run ./cmd/reconify capabilities`
- Published capabilities schema: `go run ./cmd/reconify schema capabilities`
- Verify `reconify.yaml`, `result.json`, `explanation.json`: `go run ./cmd/reconify --agent verify` (schema: `schema verification`)
- Infer a config from two files: `go run ./cmd/reconify config infer LEFT RIGHT`

## CLI Exit Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Success |
| 1 | Unexpected or internal error |
| 2 | Config, validation, or usage error (bad YAML, missing pair/source, wrong column, unknown command or flag, wrong argument count; usage errors were exit 1 before this change) |
| 3 | Reconcile completed with unmatched rows (only when `--fail-if-unmatched` is set) |
| 4 | Reconcile completed with exception events: `amount_diff`, `timing_diff`, or unmatched (only when `--fail-if-exceptions` is set; takes precedence over code 3 when both flags are set) |
| 5 | `reconify verify` found a failing check (stale `file_pattern`, source mismatch, non-reproducible result, inconsistent explanation); code 2 is used instead when the config is invalid |

Use `--error-format json` to get `reconify.engine.diagnostic.v1` errors on stderr. The envelope keeps
the legacy `error` and `code` fields and adds `ok`, `schema`, and nested diagnostic details.

- `CONFIG_INVALID` from validation carries `details.errors`: `[{"path": "sources.left.parser.date_col", "message": "required field is missing"}]`. With several pairs and no `--pair`, `details.pairs` lists them; a config with exactly one pair defaults `--pair` for `reconcile` and `verify`.
- `USAGE_ERROR` (category `usage`, exit 2, legacy code `usage_error`) covers unknown commands and flags, wrong argument counts, and invalid flag values. `details.usage` is the usage line and `details.did_you_mean` names the closest command or flag.
- `VERIFICATION_FAILED` (category `verification`, exit 5) comes from `reconify verify`.
- `RECONIFY_TRACE_FILE=<path>` appends one JSON line per process: `{"argv":[...],"exit_code":2,"duration_ms":14,"diagnostic_code":"CONFIG_INVALID"}`.

## Output Formats

**`reconcile` command** (flag: `--format`):

| Format | Memory | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `json` (default) | Buffers all | `--deterministic` stable sort; `--audit` compatible |
| `json-stream` | Low GC | Streams each event; bytes accumulate; `--audit` compatible |
| `ndjson` | O(1) | One JSON line per event; crash-safe; recommended for large jobs |
| `csv` | O(1) | Fixed schema; no grouped events |
| `table` | Buffers all | Human-readable ASCII; no grouped events |

**`parse` command** (flag: `--format`): `ndjson` (default), `csv`, `table`, `json`

## NDJSON Event Types

Each line is `{"type":"<name>","data":{...}}`. Events are emitted in this order:

```
{"type":"run_info","data":{"run_id":"...","timestamp":"2025-01-15T06:00:00Z","tool_version":"0.3.0","files":{...},"pair_config":{...}}}
{"type":"match","data":{"left":{"id":"L001","date":"2025-01-10T00:00:00Z","amount":10000,"currency":"USD","reference":"TXN-001","name":"Acme Corp","source":"bank"},"right":{"id":"R001","date":"2025-01-10T00:00:00Z","amount":10000,"currency":"USD","reference":"TXN-001","name":"Acme Corp","source":"psp"}}}
{"type":"amount_diff","data":{"left":{"id":"L002","amount":10050,"reference":"TXN-002","source":"bank"},"right":{"id":"R002","amount":10000,"reference":"TXN-002","source":"psp"},"diff_minor":50}}
{"type":"timing_diff","data":{"left":{"id":"L003","date":"2025-01-10T00:00:00Z","reference":"TXN-003","source":"bank"},"right":{"id":"R003","date":"2025-01-13T00:00:00Z","reference":"TXN-003","source":"psp"},"days_diff":3}}
{"type":"unmatched_left","data":{"id":"L004","amount":5000,"reference":"TXN-004","source":"bank"}}
{"type":"unmatched_right","data":{"id":"R005","amount":2000,"reference":"TXN-005","source":"psp"}}
{"type":"duplicate","data":{"source":"bank","reference":"TXN-006","transactions":[{"id":"L006a"},{"id":"L006b"}]}}
{"type":"grouped_match","data":{"left":{"id":"L007","amount":30000,"reference":"INST-001","source":"bank"},"rights":[{"id":"R007a","amount":10000},{"id":"R007b","amount":10000},{"id":"R007c","amount":10000}]}}
{"type":"ambiguous_group","data":{"reference":"TXN-008","left_rows":[{"id":"L008a"},{"id":"L008b"}],"rights":[{"id":"R008"}]}}
{"type":"summary","data":{"total_left":100,"total_right":98,"matched":90,"unmatched_left":4,"unmatched_right":2,"amount_diff_count":2,"timing_diff_count":1,"duplicate_count":2,"match_rate_pct":90.0,"reconciled_rate_pct":93.0}}
```

`run_info` is only emitted when `--audit` is set and is always the first line. `summary` is always the last line. Transaction `amount` fields are always in **minor units** (e.g. cents, kobo).

The `summary` event carries three additive metadata fields: `currency` (base currency for monetary totals), `result_mode` (emission mode applied; omitted when `all`), and `run_id` (telemetry run identifier; omitted when telemetry is disabled).

## Result Emission Modes

Use `--result-mode` or `result_mode` in pair config to control which events appear in the output.

| Mode | Description |
|---|---|
| `all` | Every event. **Default.** |
| `exceptions_only` | Unmatched, diffs, duplicates, ambiguous groups. Clean matches suppressed. |
| `summary_only` | Only the final summary. All item events suppressed. |

CLI flag overrides pair config when explicitly set. Filtering is at the writer boundary — classification counts and monetary totals in the summary are never affected.

## Common Stderr Messages and Their Meaning

| Message | Exit code | Meaning / Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `❌ reconify.yaml is invalid: ...` | 2 | Config validation failed. Read the listed errors and fix the YAML. |
| `[x] date_col "Date" not found in input fields` | 2 | Column name mismatch. Run `config check-source` and copy the exact header. |
| `failed to load config: open reconify.yaml: no such file` | 2 | Config file not found. Use `--config` flag or set `RECONIFY_CONFIG`. |
| `pair "X" not found in config` | 2 | Pair name typo or wrong `--pair` flag. |
| `no files match pattern "data/*.csv"` | 2 | File pattern resolved to no files. Path is relative to the config file directory. |
| `reconciliation has unmatched rows` | 3 | `--fail-if-unmatched` set and unmatched rows exist. Check the summary event for counts. |
| `reconciliation produced exception events (amount_diff, timing_diff, or unmatched)` | 4 | `--fail-if-exceptions` set and any `amount_diff`, `timing_diff`, or unmatched event was emitted. Superset of `--fail-if-unmatched`; code 4 takes precedence over code 3 when both flags are set. |
| `warning: --deterministic has no effect for --format="ndjson"` | — | `--deterministic` only works with `--format=json`. |

## Config Schema

Run `go run ./cmd/reconify config schema` for the full machine-readable JSON schema.

Minimal valid `reconify.yaml`:

```yaml
version: 1
sources:
  bank:
    file_pattern: "data/bank/*.csv"
    parser:
      type: csv
      date_col: "Date"
      date_layout: "2006-01-02"   # Go layout, not strftime
      amount_col: "Amount"
      multiplier: 100              # dollar → cents
      ref_col: "Reference"
  psp:
    file_pattern: "data/psp/*.csv"
    parser:
      type: csv
      date_col: "Date"
      date_layout: "2006-01-02"
      amount_col: "Amount"
      multiplier: 100
      ref_col: "Reference"
pairs:
  bank_vs_psp:
    left: bank
    right: psp
    date_window: "1d"
    amount_tolerance_minor: 0
    name_mode: none
```
